findings.fix: Cite `TauCeti.Probability.integral_rpow_mul_one_sub_rpow_betaMeasure` and `integrable_rpow_mul_one_sub_rpow_betaMeasure_iff` in the section docstring as the real-exponent predecessors, keeping the `integral_pow_betaMeasure` mention as the natural-index case.
findings.issue: Section F credits TauCeti's `integral_pow_betaMeasure` (natural raw moments) as the predecessor, but the closer existing results are `integral_rpow_mul_one_sub_rpow_betaMeasure` (the real-exponent moment `beta (α+q) (β+s) / beta α β`, i.e. exactly the real-N case of `mellinDis_betaPDFReal` at `q = N-1, s = 0`) and `integrable_rpow_mul_one_sub_rpow_betaMeasure_iff` (the sharp criterion `0 < α + q`, i.e. the half plane of `mellinDisConvergent_betaPDFReal`). The docstring understates how much of the statement already exists upstream.

summary: The Beta-density Mellin transform itself is new and reuses Mathlib's betaIntegral API properly, but two of the three index-1 helpers are consumer-less special cases of lemmas that already exist (one in the same file, one in Strip.lean), and the credit note names the natural-index TauCeti lemma rather than the real-exponent one that actually covers the real-N case.
